create_node: create a Node object with a label and optional type for graph rendering
create_edge: create an Edge object connecting two Node objects with an optional label
create_graph: create a Graph object containing a frozenset of Nodes and Edges for rendering
topologically_sort_nodes: yield nodes in topologically sorted order from an iterable of Edge objects
render_agentflow_subgraph: build a subgraph of Nodes and Edges to render an AgentFlow agent visualization
